objective: mean(accuracy, integration_composite, (ARI+1)/2, 1/(1+population_MSE)); fixed configurable engineering choice
reference: default FMT genome trained from scratch at the identical budget and seed
propagation: retain every qualified candidate; next round starts from best reproducible incumbent; if no improvement, retain incumbent and continue until configured round/patience limit
confirmation: three matched independent seeds; mean gain >= 0.002, at least two positive paired gains, all seeds within task regression limits
test_policy: validation-only search and selection; freeze selected checkpoints before one descriptive re-evaluation on the already published test split; no claim of a new untouched test
integration_objective: observed-expression reconstruction + gradient-reversal batch CE; no annotation/niche/development label supervision
scope: four independent tasks by default; optional spatial_completion adds a fifth independent checkpoint
component_catalog: generated from nanobrain.component_catalog; upstream neural primitives and selectable task heads
completion_input: held-out values masked in independent completion training and evaluation
spatial_context: one-hop within-split expression context; independently verified sections only; missing geometry = self loop
parallelism: one independent training/evaluation process per GPU, GPUs 0-7; no multi-task gradient sharing
checkpoint_retention: final-step weights plus genome/config/seed per task; all train/validation metrics retained; interrupted unfinished tasks restart from scratch
